defect: The change closes the JSON file right after reading the last buffer via CloseJSONFile, which spins until requested_reads equals actual_reads; reads served from the cache never bump actual_reads and Reset never clears the counters, so scans after a reset spin forever (deadlock).
reason: The fix moves this added close call in json_scan.cpp and repairs the counters added by the same change in buffered_json_reader.cpp, so the deadlock comes from this change's close-file mechanism.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(state.ht_index < gstate.finalized_hts.size()) reads the shared state.ht_index without the lock after it was copied to the local ht_index, so another thread can advance it and fire the assertion spuriously in debug builds.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added assertion with one on the local ht_index.

defect: The fix repairs the second loop added by the intermediate commit d189a68, which re-evaluated the IN constants without casting them; in 4631d33 the constants were cast in place by TryCastAs.
reason: The uncast-constant defect the fix repairs was introduced by d189a68, not by this change (whose own partial-rewrite problem d189a68 had already removed).

defect: The fix moves the test CSV files into a test directory and adds more copy test cases; the invalid-UTF8 test added by this change is only re-pathed.
reason: Both the change and the fix's edits to this file are test-only, with no defect in the added lines.

defect: The fix makes UnshredTypedArray handle non-flat or selected list vectors (list data via the unified format, child_size and offsets compacted per selected row), needed by later shredded-vector emission and by the child_sel/row_sel code added in 560020264b4 and 163ee1d7c45.
reason: In this work-in-progress commit the list path consistently assumed flat vectors and was correct for them; the repaired failures arise from later commits.

defect: The fix replaces the name-based CheckForeignKeyDependencies with real foreign-key dependency edges and depth-first ordering so a primary-key table's later dependents (e.g. an index) are written after the FK table, avoiding a crash when the checkpoint is reloaded.
reason: The ordering problem stems from the generic dependency-based export order of 800873a, which ignored foreign keys entirely; this change only partly addressed it and did not introduce the failure.

defect: The fix redesigns the export ordering (stack, ExportDependencies with FK edges) and removes the OrderEntries member declaration this change added.
reason: The header only declared a refactored helper; nothing in these lines was broken.

defect: HTTPParams::ReadFrom reads enable_server_cert_verification and ca_cert_file but returns the struct without them, so the settings are ignored, and ca_cert_file is a std::string_view taken via Value::GetValue<std::string_view>, which is unsupported and would dangle.
reason: The fix switches ca_cert_file to string/ToString and returns both new fields, repairing lines this change added.

defect: The fix corrects the WIP test's expectation that the catalog error appears only at Execute; it now checks the error on the pending result.
reason: Both the change and the fix only modify a test.

defect: The fix removes the unused make_reference helper for case_insensitive_map.
reason: Cleanup of an unused helper; the added template was not defective.

defect: In this file the fix only drops the identifier('0') default; the commit's real defect, that TransformParamRef no longer sets identifier so every parameter is '$0', is repaired in transform_param_ref.cpp.
reason: Once the transformer sets the identifier the default here is irrelevant, so the fix's edit to this file repairs no defect located in this file's lines.

defect: The fix sizes the combined selection vector by the sum of the selected child-list lengths, because ListVector::GetListSize was too small for dictionary/constant list vectors (fuzzer issue 135).
reason: The undersized buffer predates this change; its attempted correction computed the wrong quantity but never made the size smaller, so the fix repairs a pre-existing defect.

defect: GenerateJoinFilters binds min/max on the build-side key and assumes a one-child aggregate, but for collated VARCHAR keys BindMinMax rewrites the call to arg_min/arg_max with an extra collated child, so the pushed-down aggregate reads a payload column that does not exist.
reason: The fix adds a bail-out for bound aggregates with more than one child to the code this commit created; the min/max collation rewrite (0c1cf7c, 2023) already existed, and 38ffc57 only made it reachable through the default collation as well.

defect: The new occupancy-based aggregate estimate multiplies the distinct counts of all grouping sets together and collapses to 0 when the product is so large that 1 - e^(-n/product) rounds to 0.
reason: The fix estimates from the largest single grouping set and handles the zero multiplier, both in lines this change added.

defect: LogStorageScanState is used polymorphically through unique_ptr<LogStorageScanState> (and DynamicCastCheck) but has no virtual destructor, so deleting an InMemoryLogStorageScanState is undefined behaviour and skips its ColumnDataScanState destructor.
reason: The fix adds the virtual destructor to the base class this change introduced.

defect: The fix removes the stray semicolon after the InMemoryLogStorage destructor body to silence a compiler warning.
reason: Formatting only; the extra semicolon also existed before this format commit and causes no defect.

defect: The added FlatVector::SetValidity(result, FlatVector::Validity(source)) assumes a flat source although the function explicitly handles constant (and can receive dictionary) vectors, giving wrong NULLs or a flat-vector assertion.
reason: The fix removes this added line and derives validity from the unified format for every vector type.

defect: The constructor now defaults the mode to THROW and ShouldThrow returns true for every hit when no conflicts were scanned, so foreign-key append verification, which never switches to SCAN, throws a constraint error on valid inserts.
reason: The fix sets SCAN mode in VerifyForeignKeyConstraint (data_table.cpp), repairing the behaviour of this change's new mode logic.

defect: The new default ManagedSelection() leaves size 0 and is only lazily initialized, so a ConflictManager that records no conflicts returns a selection whose Size() does not match the input, breaking FirstMissingMatch and foreign-key append verification.
reason: The fix replaces the constructors this change added with ManagedSelection(size, initialize) so the size is always set; the effect shows only through conflict_manager and data_table.

defect: Changing && to || makes sqlite3_column_bytes also call sqlite3_column_blob after a successful text fetch and return 0 whenever either conversion fails.
reason: The fix reverts exactly this change an hour later.

defect: Declaring the member as unqualified 'map<T, size_t> *map' changes the meaning of the name map inside the struct (a GCC compile error), and the chunk_collection include was removed although ChunkCollection is still used.
reason: The fix renames the member to hist and restores the include; its GetType edits are only merge adaptations.

defect: The fix makes InitCompression return make_uniq directly and adds an explicit destructor to get the amalgamation build to compile.
reason: The likely culprit, returning a local unique_ptr<Derived> as unique_ptr<Base>, already existed since e4db440, and the fix's own message is unsure what broke, so it cannot be tied to lines this change added.

defect: Defaulting unpruned columns to VARCHAR inside the dialect-detection loop overwrites the candidate lists saved into best_sql_types_candidates, so later type refinement can no longer find the real type of columns that were all NULL in the first chunk, and the VARCHAR count is skewed.
reason: The fix moves the VARCHAR default to the final type assignment, repairing the placement this change introduced (a test failed); the later refinement code is outside the diff.

defect: Evaluating every foldable child with ExpressionExecutor::EvaluateScalar at bind time throws for expressions that error (e.g. failing casts) even when the error would be optimized away or never evaluated.
reason: The fix switches to TryEvaluateScalar and skips children that fail, repairing the condition this change added.

defect: The fix re-enables TPC-DS queries 76, 82 and 97 after repairing a variable-name clash in join_order_optimizer.cpp.
reason: This file's change only disabled failing queries in a test; the fix's edit here is a test change.

defect: InitializeScan now keeps state.file_handle if one is already open, so when a scan state moves on to another file the reader keeps reading the previous file.
reason: The fix restores unconditional reopening, removing the guard this change added; seeing it requires knowing the callers reuse the scan state across files.

defect: The fix replaces the GIL-wrapper member-order hack and eager loading in member initializers, added later in 71f5566, with explicit LoadModule calls under gil_scoped_acquire.
reason: The suspicious GIL code comes from later commits; this change's own dangling py::object* pointers were already fixed by 92375df, not by this fix.

defect: The fix redesigns cache loading (explicit LoadModule/LoadAttribute under the GIL) and removes the RegisteredObject storage that 71f5566 added.
reason: This change only switched the cached type to PyObject* and contains no defect the fix repairs.

defect: On a metadata-cache hit HTTPFileHandle::Initialize returns early before allocating read_buffer (returning a null response), so later reads use a null buffer.
reason: The fix allocates the read buffer in the cache-hit path this change added.

defect: NextSingleJoin gathers the build-side values, which marks NULLs stored in the hash table, and then resets the null mask so that only unmatched rows are NULL, losing those NULL values.
reason: The fix moves GatherResult after the null-mask setup in the function this change implemented.

defect: The fix corrects static_cast<BitpackingAnalyzeState<hugeint_t>&> in the generic BitpackingAnalyze and BitpackingFinalAnalyze, introduced by 8d18df2, and drops the redundant hugeint specialization.
reason: The bad cast was introduced by a later commit; the specialization this change added was merely redundant.

defect: The fix temporarily disables the work-in-progress perfect hash join and continues building its structure; the non-numeric statistics bug it targets is in plan_comparison_join.cpp.
reason: This change only reorders the uniqueness check and starts the WIP build function; no defect in its lines is repaired.

defect: The fix checks the type of the join statistics instead of op.types[0] before reinterpreting them as NumericStatistics.
reason: Treating non-numeric statistics as numeric was already possible before, when there was no check at all; this change's check was incomplete but introduced no new failure.

defect: The new RepeatFunctionData constructor ignores its value parameter, so the repeated value is a default-constructed Value.
reason: The fix initializes the value member that this change added but forgot to set.

defect: The new LogicalGet constructor initializes names with move(names), i.e. from the not-yet-initialized member itself, instead of returned_names.
reason: The fix changes exactly this initializer to move(returned_names).

defect: The fix replaces BinaryExecutor::SelectFlatLoop in the zone-map filter with a dedicated selection loop.
reason: This change only renamed VectorOperations::SelectFlatLoop to BinaryExecutor::SelectFlatLoop; the repaired filter behaviour does not come from the rename.

defect: The fix also finalizes root metrics on the EXPLAIN ANALYZE path, which the !is_explain_analyze guard already skipped before this change.
reason: The missing EXPLAIN ANALYZE metrics predate this refactor; its own by-value loop bug was fixed by 48a0f71, not by this fix.

defect: The fix changes the breadth-first heuristic from 'no sink anywhere under the union' to 'the LHS contains a sink and can saturate the threads'.
reason: This refines a pipeline-scheduling heuristic that affects performance and memory, not correctness.

defect: S3UrlParse treats any query string containing a '.' as part of the key, so supported query parameters such as s3_endpoint=host.domain are dropped and appended to the object path.
reason: The fix removes the '.' heuristic this change added.

defect: The fix uses CreateSortKeyWithValidity so that NULL 'by' values stay NULL in arg_min/arg_max; the CreateSortKey call already existed before this change.
reason: This change only replaced input_count with count; the NULL handling bug predates it.
